Rashi on Keritot 6a:13:1.english: There the heifer - There its burial shall be forever.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:14:1.hebrew: הערופה - משמע היא אין, אחרינא לא:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:14:1.english: [The heifer] that had its neck broken - [This] implies: this one, yes; another, no.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:1.hebrew: הצרי - שרף נטף, כדמפרש לקמן: שרף [הנוטף] מעצי הקטף. ושרף היינו מידי דמנטף מן העץ, וקורין גומ"א:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:1.english: The balm - Dripping resin, as [the Gemara] explains later: "resin [that drips] from the balsam trees." And seraf [resin] is something that drips from the tree, which they call gome [gum].

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:11.english: The smoke raiser - The name of an herb.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:12.english: Jordan amber - An herb that grows on the bank of the Jordan.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:2.hebrew: צפורן - שחלת דמתרגמינן טופרא, שחלקה כצפורן:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:2.english: Onycha [tziporen] - [This is the biblical] shechelet, which we translate [into Aramaic] as tufra, [so called] because it is smooth like a fingernail.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:4.hebrew: שבולת נרד - חד הוא, ובלעז שפיג"א:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:4.english: Spikenard - It is one [ingredient], and in the vernacular [Old French], espiga [spikenard].

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:5.english: Kilufah - A spice, and this is what is called cinnamon.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:6.hebrew: (ט' קבין) - סך הכל שס"ח מנין:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:6.english: (Nine kav) - The total [of the spices] is 368 maneh.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:8.hebrew: כרשינא - הבא מאותו מקום. ל"א, עשב הנקרא אירב"ה שנוטי"א שעושין ממנו בורית שקורין ספוני, מפי הרב הגדול:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:8.english: Karshina [Kersannah] - Which comes from that place. Another interpretation: an herb called erba sanotia, from which they make borit [lye] that is called sapone [soap]; [this explanation is] from the mouth of the Great Rabbi.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:9.hebrew: יין קפריסין - שבא ממקום ששמו קפרס. ע"א בגליון: יין קפריסין — שעושין מקפרא של אילן הוא, ששמו קפרס, כגון הצלף והקפרס. מ"ר:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:15:9.english: Cyprus wine [yein kafrisin] - [Wine] that comes from a place whose name is Kafras [Cyprus]. Another explanation in the margin: Yein kafrisin — [wine] that they make from the kafra of a tree; it is [a plant] whose name is kafras, as in [the phrase] "the caper bush [hatzalaf] and the caper husk [vehakafras]" [from my teacher].

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:1.english: He has disqualified it - As it is written: "For any leaven or any honey" (Leviticus 2:11).

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:2.hebrew: חייב מיתה - כי עייל ביוה"כ, דכתיב (שם טז): "ואל יבא בכל עת אל הקודש וגו' ולא ימות וגו' בזאת יבא אהרן וגו'". וכי מעייל קטרת שלא כהלכתה, ביאה ריקנית היא וחייב מיתה:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:2.english: Liable [to] death - When he enters [the Holy of Holies] on Yom Kippur, as it is written (there, [ch.] 16): "That he come not at all times into the holy place, etc., that he die not, etc.; with this shall Aaron come, etc." And when he brings in incense not in accordance with its law, it is an empty entry, and he is liable [to] death.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:3.hebrew: רשב"ג - לפרושי אתא:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:3.english: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel - He comes to explain [what the balm is].

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:5.english: So that it should be pleasant - For it is black.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:6.english: So that it should be strong - That its scent should be strong.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:16:7.english: Into the Temple - For they would compound [the incense] in the Temple courtyard.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:17:1.hebrew: מסייע ליה כו' - מדלא מפרש ליה (לברא בשעת שריית) סמנים ויתנו בה מי רגלים, מסייע ליה דקאמר כל מעשיה בקדש, בעזרה:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:17:1.english: [This] supports him, etc. - Since [the Baraita] does not specify [to take it] outside at the time of soaking the spices and put urine in it, it supports him, who says [that] all of its actions [must be performed] in the sacred [area] — [namely,] in the Temple Courtyard.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:18:1.hebrew: המקדיש נכסיו - קיי"ל סתם הקדשות לבדק הבית:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:18:1.english: One who consecrates his possessions - We hold [that] unspecified consecrations [are] for Temple maintenance.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:18:2.hebrew: והיו בהן דברים הראויין לקרבן ציבור - דקיי"ל: המקדיש נכסיו ויש בהן דבר הראוי למזבח, אינו יוצא מידי מזבח לעולם. הראוי ליחיד — מוכרין אותו ליחיד הצריך קרבן; והראוי לציבור — א"א להקריבו, דבעי לקנותו מתרומת הקופות. הילכך, נותנין אותה לאומנין בשכרן. ובגמרא מפרש: באומני בית אבטינס שהיו נוטלין קטרת, במס' שקלים בפרק התרומה מה היו עושין (פ"ד ה"ד):
Rashi on Keritot 6a:18:2.english: And there were among them items suitable for a communal offering - For it is established for us: [If] one consecrates his property and there is among it something suitable for the altar, it never leaves [the jurisdiction of] the altar. That which is suitable for an individual [offering], they sell to an individual who needs an offering; and that which is suitable for a communal [offering], it is impossible to sacrifice it [directly], as it must be purchased from the donation of the [shekel] baskets. Therefore, they give it to the artisans as their wages. And in the Gemara it explains: [This refers to] the artisans of the House of Avtinas, who would take incense [as their wages, as taught] in Tractate Shekalim, in the chapter [entitled] HaTerumah Mah Hayu Osin (4:4).

Rashi on Keritot 6a:19:1.hebrew: הא תנא להו - התם במסכת שקלים, והני ראויין ליחיד כמו לצבור:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:19:1.english: Behold, he taught them - There, in Tractate Shekalim; and these are suitable for an individual just as for the community.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:19:2.english: Domesticated animal and wild animal - [This is] not exact.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:19:3.hebrew: אלא לאו קטרת - דאינו ראוי אלא לציבור. אלמא, עושין קטרת מן החולין ובחוץ, וקשיא לר' יוסי בר' חנינא:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:19:3.english: Rather, is it not incense - For it is suitable only for the community. It follows that they make incense from unconsecrated [materials] and outside [the Temple], and [this is] difficult for Rabbi Yosei bar Rabbi Ḥanina.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:1:1.english: A reflection of a reflection - A shadow of its shadow.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:1:2.hebrew: ולאו מילתא היא - דלא ליעביד איניש הכי, דלמא הוי סימנא בישא, ומצער נפשיה, ומיתרע מזליה:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:1:2.english: And it is nothing - [Meaning] that a person should not do this, lest it be a bad omen, and he distress himself, and his fortune turn bad.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:1.hebrew: באותה הניתנת כו' - לעולם בקודש נעשית, ולא הספיקו ללוקחה הימנו עד שהקדישה:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:1.english: To that which is given, etc. - Actually, it was made in the sanctuary, and they had not yet managed to purchase it from him before he consecrated it.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:2.hebrew: מותר קטרת - שבכל שנה היה נשאר מאותן ג' מנים יתירין שכהן גדול מכניס, ולא היה מקטיר אלא מלא חפניו, ונשאר המותר. ואותו מותר לא היה ראוי לשנה הבאה מניסן ואילך, דניסן ראש השנה דתרומת שקלים, דאמרה תורה: חדש והבא קרבן מתרומה חדשה — במסכת ראש השנה (דף ז.). ומה היו עושין בו:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:2.english: The leftover incense - For each year, [some] was left over from those three extra manehs that the High Priest brings in, and he would burn only his handfuls, so the remainder was left over. And that remainder was not fit for the following year, from Nisan onward, as Nisan is the New Year for the contribution of the shekels, for the Torah said: “Renew and bring an offering from the new contribution” — in tractate Rosh Hashanah (page 7a). And [so:] What did they do with it?

Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:3.english: They would set aside - From the consecrated property of the Temple upkeep, the wages of the artisans who repair the Temple upkeep.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:4.hebrew: ומחללין - את מותר זה על (מותר) מעות. דכל זמן שהיא בקדושתה אינן רשאין לתתה לאומנין, דכל דבר שראוי למזבח אינו יוצא מידי מזבח לעולם:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:20:4.english: And they desacralize - This surplus [incense] onto the (surplus) money. For as long as it is in its sacred state, they are not permitted to give it to the artisans, for anything that is fit for the Altar never leaves [the domain of] the Altar.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:21:1.hebrew: ל"ג תני רב יהודה אלא ה"ג בכולהו מותרין תני חוזרין כו' והכא לא תני - והא מדתני בכולהו מותרין הניתנין לאומנין חוזרין ולוקחין אותן כו', והכא לא תני הכי — מכלל דלאו בקטרת גמורה קמיירי, אלא בשנעשית חולין, וקרי לה ראויין לקרבנות צבור? ותיובתא דר' יוסי בר' חנינא:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:21:1.english: We do not read: “Rav Yehuda taught,” but rather, this is the reading: “With regard to all leftovers, [the tanna] teaches: 'They return...' etc., and here he does not teach [this]” - And behold, from the fact that regarding all leftovers that are given to artisans [the tanna] teaches: “They return and purchase them etc.,” and here he does not teach this — does this imply that [the mishna] is not dealing with complete incense, but rather with [incense] that had become unconsecrated, yet [the tanna] calls it “suitable for communal offerings”? And [consequently, it remains] a refutation of Rabbi Yosei bar Ḥanina.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:22:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רב יוסף - מאי ראויין דקתני? אחד מסממני הקטרת, ולא קטרת פטומה:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:22:1.english: Rather, Rav Yosef says - What is [the meaning of] 'suitable' that [the mishna] teaches? One of the ingredients of the incense, and not blended incense.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:23:1.english: 368 manehs - For this is how the tally of the spices [listed] above comes out. Borit [lye], wine, and the smoke-raising herb are not spices.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:2:2.english: Rubya - Fenugreek. And [of] these, there are [some] that grow quickly and there are [some] that are sweet.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:2.hebrew: ולא על אפדני דפומבדיתא - שלסטין היו, כדאמרינן בהעור והרוטב (חולין קכז.): פומבדיתאה אלוייך, אשני אושפיזך:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:2.english: And not in the palaces of Pumbedita - For they were robbers, as we say in [the chapter] Ha'or Veharotev (Chullin 127a): "[If] a Pumbeditan accompanies you, change your inn."

Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:3.hebrew: גילדנא סריא - דג קטן מוסרח, כדאמרי' בפ"ק דמועד קטן (דף יא.), כוורא סמוך למיסרחיה מעלי:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:3.english: Rotten fish - A small, foul-smelling fish, as we say in the first chapter of Moed Katan (11a): "A fish close to spoiling is superior."

Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:4.hebrew: מכותחא דרמי כיפי - אפילו כותח שהוא משובח וחזק, שמשבר את האבן כששופכין הימנו ע"ג האבן, אעפ"כ לא תאכלו הימנו, כדאמרי' בפ' אלו עוברין (פסחים מב.): שלשה דברים נאמרו בכותח — מטמטם את הלב כו':
Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:4.english: Than kutḥa that throws rocks - Even kutach that is superior and strong, which breaks a stone when one pours from it onto the stone, nevertheless do not eat from it, as we say in the chapter [entitled] Eilu Overin (Pesachim 42a): Three things were said regarding kutach — it dulls the heart, etc.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:4:5.english: Rocks [keifei] - Rock, as we translate [the Hebrew] sela [into Aramaic as] keifa.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:6:1.english: And if he smelled it - [If he smelled] the incense of the community, [he is] exempt.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:7:1.english: Sound - One who derives benefit from the sound of the harps and lyres of the service vessels.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:7:2.english: And sight - One who derives benefit from the beautiful appearance of the Sanctuary.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:8:1.hebrew: ומשני ריח - דקאמר אין בו מעילה לאחר שעלתה תמרתו, שנעשה מצוותו; וכי קאמר מעל, קודם לכן:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:8:1.english: And [the Gemara] answers: Smell - That which it says there is no misuse [of consecrated property] [is] after its column of smoke has risen, since its mitzvah has been performed; and when it says one is guilty of misuse, [that is] prior to that.

Rashi on Keritot 6a:9:1.hebrew: תרומת הדשן - מועלין בה, דכתיב "ושמו", דמשמע שם תהא גניזתו:
Rashi on Keritot 6a:9:1.english: The removal of the ashes - One is liable for misusing it, as it is written, "and he shall put it [beside the altar]" [Leviticus 6:3], which implies [that] there shall be its permanent resting place.
